args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 began failing health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) immediately following its deployment, with error rate ~18%. Automated rollback executed to the most recent previously-healthy production release, v2.3.0, across all regions. Post-rollback verification: service healthy in all regions, error rate ~0.2%. v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified; v2.3.1-rc in staging was also unhealthy, suggesting a systemic issue in that code line.
args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions; rolled back to v2.3.0

trace.final:
All done. Here's a summary:

**Diagnosis:**
- checkout-api was on v2.3.1, unhealthy in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.
- Deployment history showed the most recent **healthy** production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0** in all production regions — rollback succeeded.
2. **Verified recovery** — the service is now healthy in all three regions with an error rate of ~0.2% (down from 18%).
3. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the failed v2.3.1 deploy, the rollback, and post-rollback health. The on-call engineer has been paged.

One note for the incident follow-up: v2.3.1-rc was also unhealthy in staging, which suggests a systemic issue in that code line worth investigating before any redeploy.
